memory_update.text: The highest-conviction Spruce Pine high-purity quartz and quartz-crucible assets appear to be private or non-US-listed, so US-listed mapping should focus on adjacent contamination-control, process-materials, gas/chemical delivery, and wafer-consumables suppliers.
ENTG should be retained as a reference anchor for ultra-clean semiconductor materials, purification, filtration, and contamination-control exposure.
ICHR should be tracked as an underfollowed direct subsystem supplier for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery, a likely second-order beneficiary of increasing process complexity.

ASYS is a small-cap speculative-shadow candidate tied to wafer-processing equipment and consumables; it requires stronger proof of AI, SiC, or advanced-substrate order pull-through before promotion to later Serenity layers.

SHECY should remain the reference anchor for the semiconductor quartz/crucible/wafer materials node because it discloses quartz crucibles, silicon wafers, quartz glass, photomask substrates, pellicles, and wafer cases.

ENTG is a high-quality but not obscure public candidate for ultra-clean semiconductor materials, filtration, purification, and contamination-control exposure; treat as underfollowed by node rather than by market cap.
ICHR is a low-attention public supplier-to-toolmakers candidate for gas and chemical fluid delivery subsystems; key risk is high customer concentration and semiconductor equipment cyclicality.
AXTI belongs in speculative shadow until primary filings confirm the scale, ownership, and customer qualification of any PBN crucible or raw-material exposure.

Direct public exposure to Spruce Pine high-purity quartz, Momentive Technologies, CoorsTek, and other crucible/material chokepoints appears limited because major assets are private, embedded, or disclosed only at subsidiary level.
For later layers, split this node into four verifiable subnodes: quartz/crucibles, silicon/compound wafers, ultra-clean chemicals/filters, and gas/liquid delivery subsystems.

Direct public exposure to high-purity quartz and semiconductor crucibles is limited; several critical operations appear private or buried inside larger chemical/materials firms, so later layers should map private suppliers and public second-order suppliers separately.
ENTG should remain in the universe as the most liquid public contamination-control and materials-purity proxy, but its market cap is above the preferred small/mid-cap range.
UCTT and ICHR are the cleaner underfollowed discovery candidates for ultra-clean gas/chemical/fluid delivery and contamination-control subsystems tied to semiconductor tools.

For this node, the practical public-market mapping should include not only quartz/crucibles/wafers but also filters, gas delivery, chemical delivery, ultra-high-purity cleaning, coatings, wafer carriers, and micro-contamination analysis.

Direct high-purity quartz and semiconductor quartz-crucible public-market exposure is scarce in US listings; Spruce Pine-linked HPQ assets appear mainly tied to private or non-US-listed entities such as Sibelco and The Quartz Corp.

For US-listed equities, the more investable map of this node likely sits in second-order ultra-clean materials, filtration, gas/chemical delivery, process-control, and wafer-cleaning suppliers rather than direct HPQ mining or crucible production.

UCTT is a higher-priority underfollowed candidate for further Layer 2 work because it combines semiconductor subsystem exposure with ultra-high-purity cleaning, analytical services, gas delivery, and chemical delivery modules.

ACMR should remain in the speculative-shadow lane until evidence confirms that cleaning step intensity, customer qualifications, and non-China adoption link its growth to the broader ultra-clean wafer-processing chokepoint.

summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found that the most direct Spruce Pine high-purity-quartz and quartz-crucible assets appear mostly private or non-US-listed, so the US-listed universe is best approached through adjacent ultra-clean materials, contamination-control, gas/chemical delivery, wafer-processing consumables, and semiconductor process subsystems. The cleanest US-listed public mappings for this pass are Entegris as a large-cap contamination-control and specialty-materials reference name, MKS Instruments as a diversified but semiconductor-exposed process-control and specialty-chemicals platform, Ichor as a smaller underfollowed fluid-delivery subsystem supplier, and Amtech Systems as a small-cap/speculative wafer-processing and consumables exposure. No buy/sell view is implied. Layer 1B expansion for the semiconductor ultra-clean materials node finds that the most direct public-market exposure is often outside the obvious AI-chip universe: Shin-Etsu as the reference leader in silicon wafers/quartz-related semiconductor materials; Entegris as a large but relatively pure contamination-control and high-purity materials supplier; Ichor as an underfollowed fluid-delivery subsystem supplier tied to process-gas and chemical delivery; and AXT as a speculative shadow candidate in compound-semiconductor substrates and related raw-material/crucible inputs.
